The verifier passes. The cube is seated in the tray slot, flat and released.

What I did:
- Opened the gripper, hovered above the cube, and set wrist roll so the jaws matched the cube's 6 degree yaw.
- Descended, read back the actual tool position, confirmed the jaw-axis error was under 1 mm, and grasped.
- Lifted, carried the cube over the slot, and adjusted roll until the cube yaw read under 1 degree.
- Lowered the cube so its bottom sat just inside the funnel, then released and let it slide into the pocket.
